$comment: TIMS — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all Bhopal geographic scoping. Edit ONLY this file, then run `npm run sync:config` from the repo root. That regenerates backend/src/config/bhopal.ts and frontend/lib/bhopal.ts, which are consumed by the FIRMS fetcher, the Overpass fetcher, every PostGIS query and the Leaflet map defaults. To scale TIMS beyond Bhopal, change this file only.

bbox.$comment: The pilot fetch envelope, exactly as specified in the SIH26162 brief. Used as the FIRMS `area` parameter and the Overpass bbox. This is a cheap API-level pre-filter, NOT the authoritative geofence — see `boundary`.

districtBbox.$comment: Envelope of the full OSM Bhopal district polygon. Provided so widening the pilot to the whole district is a one-line change (swap which bbox the fetchers read).

boundary.$comment: Authoritative geofence. A detection is a *Bhopal incident* only when PostGIS ST_Within places it inside this polygon — not merely inside the bbox.

map.$comment: Leaflet defaults. Centre is the centroid of the pilot bbox, which is central Bhopal.

thresholds.$comment: Named constants for the risk engine and the ML weak-labeller. No magic numbers at call sites.

classification.$comment: Thresholds for the transparent rule classifier and the ML weak-labeller, derived from the ACTUAL distribution of the 434 real FIRMS detections ingested for the Bhopal pilot bbox (2026-02-06 to 2026-05-01). Observed percentiles: FRP p25=1.11 p50=2.43 p75=7.74 p90=15.44 p99=69.89 MW; brightness p50=317.9 p90=350.9 K; distance-to-facility p10=2687 p25=4368 p50=5903 m. Bhopal's thermal sources are kilns, workshops, crop-residue and forest fires - not refinery flares - so national-scale thresholds would put 71% of real detections in UNKNOWN.

riskWeights.$comment: Rule-based risk scoring weights, per the SIH26162 brief. Must sum to 100.

riskBands.$comment: Inclusive lower bound for each band. 0-30 LOW, 31-60 MEDIUM, 61-80 HIGH, 81-100 CRITICAL.

firms.$comment: FIRMS hard limit is dayRange 1..5 - verified empirically on 2026-09-15 (HTTP 400 'Invalid day range. Expects [1..5]' for 7 and 10). NRT products cover roughly the trailing 2 months; SP (archive) products cover history. Archive availability as reported by the data_availability endpoint on 2026-09-15: VIIRS_SNPP_SP 2012-01-20..2026-04-27, VIIRS_NOAA20_SP 2018-04-01..2026-05-31, MODIS_SP 2000-11-01..2026-06-30.
